boas-vindas.title: Where everything lives
boas-vindas.body: Two minutes through the essentials of DOQYN. You can leave at any point. The tour comes back from the ? in the top bar.

biblioteca.title: Library
biblioteca.body: Every document that enters DOQYN lives here. This is the screen where you browse, search and open. The rest of the menu is just slices of it.

enviar.title: Upload a document
enviar.body: From here, or by dragging the file anywhere on the screen. The AI reads the document, recognizes what it is, and proposes a name, a class and metadata before you confirm.

classes.title: Folders are classes
classes.body: Each folder is a class of document: contract, invoice, power of attorney. The document lands in the class because the AI recognized what it is, not because someone dragged it there.

assinar.title: To sign
assinar.body: Whatever is waiting for your signature is kept apart from the rest. You sign inside DOQYN, and people from outside sign through a link, with no account needed.

pedidos.title: Requests
pedidos.body: When a document is missing, you ask for it instead of waiting. The request tracks who has already sent theirs and who has not, and becomes a document in the Library as soon as it arrives.

usuarios.title: Users and groups
usuarios.body: Who joins the organization and which group they land in. The group is what governance sees: access is granted to the group, never to a person on their own.

regras.title: Access rules
regras.body: This is where access is written: connect a group to a class and choose the verbs (view, download, upload). Download allows the middle ground of requiring approval; the others are yes or no.

matriz.title: Access matrix
matriz.body: The reading of what the rules produced: by person, who reaches each document; by group, what each one gets, verb by verb. The matrix changes nothing — it exists so you can check before finding out the hard way.

ia.title: How much the AI decides
ia.body: The upload and automatic-reading policy applies to everything that comes in: how far the AI classifies on its own, and when it hands the document back for human review.

auditoria.title: Audit
auditoria.body: Every action on a document becomes a record: who viewed it, who downloaded it, who signed it, and when. It is what backs the system's word when someone asks later.

ajuda.title: The tour lives here
ajuda.body: Whenever you need it, this ? brings the walkthrough back, from the start and on whatever screen you are on.
